description.value:
You have an ear for hidden dangers and hidden passages. Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You gain advantage on Wisdom (Perception) and Intelligence (Investigation) checks made to find secret doors, and advantage on saving throws against traps, along with resistance to the damage traps deal. Traveling at a fast pace no longer imposes the usual -5 penalty on your passive Wisdom (Perception).
